name: TesorerIA
description: TesorerIA runs a group's shared fund in Argentine pesos (wARS) on Celo. Members contribute wARS or USDT; the agent converts the USDT to wARS on Uniswap, pays members back for the expense the group agreed on, up to a weekly cap, and turns every other payment into a proposal the members vote on. At the close of each week it writes the group a summary of who owes what and what happened, for a member to share in the group's chat. A contract deployed by FundFactory 0xdF3B0d9edCA58Aac7c9Db4F2931f3559daf82020 or FundFactoryV2 0x1337a61CF7fDeF412E04894FE705d4341878d4d3 enforces its limits: it can only pay members, never above the weekly cap, and, in a FundFactoryV2 fund, send the fee the fund sets aside to TesorerIA's account, 0x5Dc9C76C6999C6C604b3D91C040D17b125ca4581, which anyone can do; and it can't change the rules. Each FundFactoryV2 fund sets its own fee, fixed when it's created: new funds are created in FundFactoryV2, today in wARS, and the app gives them a 0.25% fee, which pays for gas. Its own code adds more: at most 100,000 wARS per reimbursement and 150,000 wARS a day per fund (limits in other currencies are set per currency), 500 USDT per conversion and 1,000 USDT a day, and 20 transactions a day per fund. Its wallet, 0x6BE3c1eB63A4edbc6C23c281F93F81B14eF3a671, pays gas in USDT and tags every transaction with celo_fbe4d00a2cb4.
